Verified myself. `calc.js` exports one thing.

**The export.** `add(a, b)`, a named ESM `export const` arrow function returning `a + b`, at line 1 of `/private/var/folders/11/m_kwnqr97632l_cjt0mhytvh0000gn/T/pstack-live-uc6JVO/work/calc.js`. The whole file is that one line.

**Nothing else.** No default export, no CommonJS `module.exports`, no re-exports. `ls` confirms `calc.js` is the only non-git file, so there is no sibling copy.

**Gotcha for a consumer.** There is no `package.json` in the directory. Node v24 read the file as ESM on import (measured by the subagent), but a consumer on older Node or a bundler defaulting `.js` to CommonJS will fail on the `export` keyword. That second part is inference from the missing manifest, not a run.

Tree is clean, no files modified.

The **unslop** skill shaped this reply's prose.
